title: Freeze telemetry and correction event schemas v1.0
summary: Define and freeze the event schemas that M1 telemetry, the weekly gj-data reports, and the M6 learning loop depend on. Frozen means: version 1.0.0, validated fixtures, forbidden-field tests, and an AUTH (design-change) approving the freeze; later changes need another AUTH.

acceptance_tests.test: data/schemas/telemetry_events.schema.json (JSON Schema 2020-12) defines a common envelope (schema_version, event_id, pseudonymous user_id, env_id, client_version, platform, ts, scale_multiplier) and the event catalogue: session_start/end, scan_started/completed/failed (quality metrics), avatar_generated/failed (durations only), play_started, fall (tier, height_A), stuck (dwell > 20 s, position in env-local A units), quit, summit_reached, route_started/completed (time, beat reached), vista_found, rating_submitted (four axes), report_submitted (reason enum).
data/schemas/correction_events.schema.json defines correction_submitted: surface id, old label, new label (Bible §4 class enum), env-local position, confidence, training_opt_in flag.
A forbidden-field test fails if any schema admits GPS, latitude/longitude, email, phone, free-text from users, raw media references, or device identifiers beyond a platform enum.
At least two fixtures per event validate; one invalid fixture per schema is rejected; pytest runs in CI.
gj-data reviews the catalogue for the weekly report needs (fall/quit/stuck heatmaps, completion rates, vista discovery, ratings) and signs off in the PR.
The PR cites APPROVED #n for the freeze; data/schemas/README.md records version 1.0.0 and the change rule.
